headline.purpose: Space Mono 36px bold tabular-nums for the total-n LCD readout and post-round-up total. The loudest glyphs on the bench.

body.purpose: 14px Space Grotesk for descriptions, alerts, and column descriptions.

label.purpose: 10px uppercase Grotesk, 0.14em tracking, weight 500, ink tint — every field label, section title, and phase tag.

shadows.name: readout-bezel

shadows.name: alloc-track-well

components.name: Settings Numeric Input
components.description: Readout-style field for precision/confidence/plot size on the settings plate: LCD fill, inner lip, mono tabular numerals, engraved label above.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; } .ds-engraved { font-family: "Space Grotesk", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 500; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.14em; color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-input-readout { height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; background: var(--readout); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 2px oklch(0.2 0.02 150 / 8%), inset 0 0 0 1px oklch(1 0 0 / 55%); color: var(--foreground); caret-color: var(--primary); font-family: "Space Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, monospace; font-size: 14px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-input-readout:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-input-readout:disabled { opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Neyman Allocation Cell
components.description: Signature readout: a spruce bar drawing to the row's exact share of max nᵢ inside a recessed well, rounded count engraved at the bar's end.
components.css: .ds-alloc { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: 176px; } .ds-alloc-track { flex: 1; height: 8px; background: var(--bench); border-radius: 1px; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 2px oklch(0.2 0.02 150 / 10%); } .ds-alloc-bar { height: 8px; background: var(--primary); border-radius: 1px; transition: width 260ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-alloc-count { flex-shrink: 0; width: 24px; font-family: "Space Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, monospace; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--foreground); }

components.name: Ledger Add Row
components.description: The "next blank line" affordance under the strata ledger: full-width dashed hairline, engraved label, hover turns spruce.
components.css: .ds-add-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: 100%; height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; margin-top: 12px; border: 1px dashed var(--input); background: transparent; color: var(--muted-foreground); cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.2s, border-color 0.2s; } .ds-add-row span { font-family: "Space Grotesk", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 500; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.14em; } .ds-add-row:hover { border-color: var(--primary); color: var(--primary); } .ds-add-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-icon { width: 14px; height: 14px; }

components.name: Excluded Stratum Row
components.description: Line-form state for invalid strata: dashed hairline rule under the row, 85% opacity, computed columns show an em-dash, allocation cell becomes an engraved amber EXCLUDED tag.
components.css: .ds-ledger-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 24px; padding: 8px 12px; font-family: "Space Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, monospace; font-size: 14px; color: var(--foreground); } .ds-excluded { border-bottom: 1px dashed var(--input); opacity: 0.85; } .ds-mono { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-dash { color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-excluded-tag { font-family: "Space Grotesk", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 500; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.14em; color: var(--destructive); }

narrative.overview:
This calculator refuses the category default of neutral SaaS cards around a spreadsheet. It presents the entire calculation as one calibrated bench instrument: engraved tracked-uppercase labels, inset LCD readout windows, numerals locked to a registration grid. The interface itself argues the number is precise and auditable — every intermediate (weighted mean, E, weighted SD/variance, N, t) sits on display with its formula symbol.

The world is light, warm, and restrained. Depth is never simulated with drop shadows — plates sit on the bench separated by hairline rules, and the only shadows in the system are inward: recessed readout wells and the allocation track. State is carried in line form — weight, dash, double rule, strike — never in hue alone. Color is rationed: spruce appears on primary actions, the headline total, and sorted-column headers; flag amber appears only where something is excluded or needs checking.

The one signature motion is the settling readout: on every recompute, numeric values ease once into place (260 ms) and each Neyman allocation bar draws to its exact proportion. Values land; they never flicker.
keyCharacteristics: Calibration-bench light theme: warm paper ground, ink-green foreground, one spruce accent, one flag amber.
Space Grotesk for every word; Space Mono for every numeral, always tabular-nums.
Engraved labels: 10px, weight 500, uppercase, 0.14em tracking, muted ink tint.
Inset LCD readout windows, never elevated cards.
Zero drop shadows; depth = inset wells + hairline rules.
Line-form state: dashed rules, double sum-rules, weight shifts — not hue alone.
Allocation bars whose length is the exact quantity; rounded count engraved at the bar's end.
Named phases in words ("EXCLUDED", "finite population correction"), never color-only status.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Spruce (#235338) and only spruce carries interactive meaning. Amber is a flag, not an accent — it never fills a primary action.

rules.name: The Ink Tint Rule
rules.body: Muted text is a tint of ink (#5f6659), never a neutral gray — the bench stays warm even in captions.

rules.name: The Rationed Accent Rule
rules.body: Spruce appears on ≤10% of any screen. Its rarity is what makes the headline total feel like the instrument's single lit display.

rules.name: The Numbers Are Mono Rule
rules.body: Every numeral on screen — inputs included — is Space Mono with tabular-nums. Nothing numeric is ever set in the sans.

rules.name: The Engraving Rule
rules.body: Labels are engraved: uppercase, 10px, weight 500, 0.14em tracking, ink tint. A label that looks like body text is a bug.

rules.name: The One Bench Rule
rules.body: Surfaces never float. If two regions need separation, use a hairline rule or an inset well — never a drop shadow.

dos: Do set every numeral in Space Mono with tabular-nums, at any size.
Do engrave labels: uppercase, 10px, weight 500, 0.14em tracking, #5f6659.
Do put computed values in inset .readout wells with their engraved formula label.
Do carry state in line form — dashed rules, double rules, weight — and name the phase in words.
Do draw allocation bars to exact proportion and animate width at 260ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1).
Do theme browser surfaces (selection, caret, focus ring, scrollbars) with the spruce/hairline tokens.
Do keep plates on the bench-value fill and separate them with 1px #d9d7cb hairlines.
donts: Don't use drop shadows. Depth is inset wells and hairlines only.
Don't introduce any accent besides spruce and flag amber.
Don't signal state with hue alone — pair color with a line form or a named phase tag.
Don't set numerals in Space Grotesk, or use a proportional numeral anywhere in the ledger or readouts.
Don't give plates an elevated "card" tone — card fill equals bench ground (#f7f6f2).
Don't round corners below 1px on bars/rules or above the radius scale on plates; the form language is ruled lines with gentle corner radii.
